Before each new Superpowers skill or command invocation, reproduce the previously agreed twelve-row activity-to-skill mapping verbatim, identify the applicable skill, load its instructions, and apply them. Read applicable AGENTS.md and README first; respect workspace permissions. Return the implementation status as {$implementationStatus}.

variables.name: nativeImplementationEvidence
variables.value: Verified: current issue-command.js retrieved through command console Issue #59 (HTTP 200, blob SHA c62a1920ddb058c2685250a03448f03d64dd2cca). It uses Node.js fs/path/crypto for local event and catalog processing but routes catalog commands through fetch to GitHub REST, so it is not yet the native dispatcher. GitHub Actions Node.js 22 is the known local runtime from workflow configuration. No native filesystem command has been implemented or executed in the repository in this step. Blocking work remains: inspect applicable documentation, implement sandboxed local dispatch and tests, and verify output/comment rendering and persistence separately. No completion claim.

variables.name: nativeImplementationEvidence
variables.value: Implemented local/stat in ChatMachines/Workflow Interactive Procedures/GitHub Command Issue/issue-command.js via Issue #59 command 6266435467. GitHub console receipt 6266442317 reports HTTP 200 write; resulting file blob SHA 9ea9a1b72bcd38b21656e3beb9fb71fa96e9a5ac. Executed a positive integration test through issue command 6266446527: receipt 6266452697 reports local/stat HTTP 200, output in 6266453062 shows the checked-out issue-command.js as type=file, size=9858. Negative traversal test in command 6266456869 was rejected by receipt 6266463723 with Invalid local path. This operation uses local Node fs.realpathSync/lstatSync and keeps issue-comment verification through the existing workflow. Other catalog operations still use GitHub REST. No separate unit-test file was added; broad coverage and further tests remain outstanding.

variables.name: nativeTestEvidence
variables.value: Verified: local-stat.test.js was created through console #59 command 6266491438; receipt 6266503939 reports HTTP 201 and blob SHA 023079fee471a5f17e148026a2fbe6559ad94c3c. The Node built-in test suite covers valid file, missing file, path traversal, absolute path, and symlink escape and imports localStat from issue-command.js. Actual GitHub Actions test execution remains unverified. Attempt to add test execution to github-command-issue.yml via console command 6266512344 was rejected in receipt 6266518563 with HTTP 403 because the GitHub App lacks workflows permission. Workflow unchanged by that attempt. Do not claim tests pass; need workflow permission or an existing authorized test-execution mechanism.

variables.name: nativeMappingEvidence
variables.value: Verified through Issue #59: map-native-operations.js exists (command 6266598727, HTTP 200 response 6266604759, blob 8ce9104a010939ff7491cde1b3ff0c7509e2cf5f). Source reads command-catalog.json, enumerates every command, emits conditional-local bindings for a conservative set of Contents, Git objects/refs, repository metadata and remote-required for unmatched operations, then writes native-operation-map.json locally. However a check for committed native-operation-map.json (command 6266610522) returned HTTP 404 in receipt 6266616595. Therefore the claimed 1,174 classified output entries and their counts are not verified as persisted in GitHub; the generator itself is not evidence of execution. Existing native runtime operation local/stat and local/test-stat with 4/4 tests verified. Next concrete implementation target: native local/read or local/list under checked-out workspace, preserving path authorization, verification, and issue-comment response. Must generate and check operation map output before asserting full catalog coverage.
